status: preregistered before new-query inference or participant enrollment
representation: bm25-46: shipping historical text on both sides; SKOS-definition ablation excluded

manifest.rules: unicode-lowercase-alphanumeric-v1; no NFC, stemming, transliteration or stopwords; IRI plus observed text; en/no/nb/nn language families and untagged; descriptions first 512 Unicode scalars; graph-local explicit wikibase:directClaim label/alias retrieval via source statements, observed predicates only, no inference or chaining

urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3.source: EEA GEMET 4.2.3 and W3C SKOS Reference 2009; explicit source-triple union
urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3.license: CC-BY-4.0 AND W3C Software and Document License (2023)

candidate_universe: Exactly the graph-qualified role-filtered documents of the pinned bm25-46 export; no new enrichment

display.blinding: HMAC-SHA256 private retained 256-bit seed and task ID; reveal only after durable submission
display.exact: Original exact IRI/label/alias; preserve BM25 first hit; multiple exact identities remain ambiguous before clipping
display.no_match: No relevant retrievable resource in the authorized graph and role, not real-world absence; any returned candidate is a false candidate on such tasks
display.scores: Hidden: neither dense nor lexical/fusion scores are ground truth or calibrated confidence

rubric: full authorized catalog and off-list relevance

humans.ids: Random anonymous R- IDs; operator attests actual participation; no names, contact details or raw text
humans.adjudication: At least two independent consenting reviewers agree on exhaustive relevance set per case; disagreements retained and excluded pending separate adjudication; never majority-vote away a conflict
humans.excluded: cannot_assess / technical_failure / withdrawn; retain planned denominator and list exclusions

scoring.intervals: Fixed-seed query-level 2000-resample descriptive 95% bootstrap; language pairs/target families are dependent; no population significance or power claim

recommendation.rule: Defer while independent human consensus, full tasks, either-language relevant/no-match coverage or new-query comparable resource measurements are missing. With complete evidence continue BM25 on any failed gate. Otherwise propose a further opt-in trial; owner approval is separate.
recommendation.human_safety: Uncertain exact-first/scope/direction/ambiguity rubric means defer; any negative judgment means continue BM25 with complete evidence.

measurement.hardware: Must be declared and frozen in a capture receipt before new queries; no new inference has run
measurement.history_hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB; native macOS arm64; CPU-only four intra-op / one inter-op threads; host scheduler; OS caches retained; no affinity or quota
measurement.timing: Same resident CPU process, same authorized corpus, paired queries; retain cold startup/end-to-end and warm distributions separately; never treat HTTP/replay timings as inference
measurement.memory: Controller HWM + direct-child HWM + nested-child HWM conservative bound including all simultaneous model/index processes; report cold startup, vector build, disk cost and scheduling

limitations: Zero actual participants/reviewers at preregistration; genuine human validation blocked.
AI-authored source anchors are not relevance gold; no-match references need full authorized retrievable catalog review.
New target families chosen without consulting their ranks; exposed targets only in declared ambiguity/direction probes. Both languages share families.
Public source corpus and exposed #50/#53 demo remain regressions; neither is an untouched holdout.
Human identity/consent are operator attestations, not cryptographic proof; anonymous IDs must not be reused across people or duplicated for one person.
Small convenience sample and correlated queries limit descriptive intervals; no product rollout or Confirmed Ask integration is authorized.
